import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import glob

# Load all Raman files and calculate I_G/I_D ratio for each
files = sorted(glob.glob('data/raman/*.csv'))
records = []
for f in files:
    df_file = pd.read_csv(f)
    # Assume first column is Shift, second is Intensity based on preview
    shift_col = df_file.columns[0]
    int_col = df_file.columns[1]
    
    x = df_file[shift_col].values
    y = df_file[int_col].values
    
    # I_G: max intensity in 1550-1620 cm-1
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    ig = np.max(y[mask_g]) if np.any(mask_g) else 0.0
    
    # I_D: max intensity in 1300-1400 cm-1
    mask_d = (x >= 1300) & (x <= 1400)
    id_val = np.max(y[mask_d]) if np.any(mask_d) else 0.0
    
    ratio = ig / id_val if id_val != 0 else 0.0
    
    records.append({
        '파일명': os.path.basename(f),
        'IG_ID': ratio
    })

# Replace the dataframe with the summary table so the bar chart can use it
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
